title: C1246 — Turbocharger (TC) Wastegate Regulating Valve Solenoid
introduction:
I read this connector sheet by separating the solenoid’s supply reference from its powertrain-controller connection. The cavity drawing leads to the matching table rows, where Function explains each connection’s role. That distinction is useful: a solenoid needs its electrical cast in the right roles before the boost-control story makes sense.

Use this page to identify connections and distinguish parts references. Physical access, probing, wire selection and replacement require separate procedures. Viewing side, operating and test conditions, gauge convention and the meanings of Size and Used are unspecified here.
